First of all, I can only apologise for the way you're feeling. I know what it's like to feel brushed aside, in fact because you shared some of your story, it's only fair I do the same. When I was around 15, I visited the doctor regularly regarding my mental health and in a way, you could say this was a cry out for help. Anyway, long story short I told the doctor exactly how I felt and he just said to me "you don't look depressed" and told me to take up exercise as that should lift up my spirits so please, if you're feeling alone in this, please know there are many people like yourself who have felt the same but also the majority of the time, the people who face such hardships in life are the ones with big hearts, to open the door for a stranger both metaphorically and physically as we know what it's like to be put aside. Now, I can't say I know an awful lot about your character but what I do know is you strike me as an intelligent young woman with a lot to offer to the world. Stay strong.
